description_en: Detaches a network instance from a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 调用DetachCenChildInstance接口卸载云企业网实例中的网络实例
kebab_example: aliyun cbn detach-cen-child-instance --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmx0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnvx0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachCenChildInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the network instance to uninstall
parameters.name: child_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：

VPC：专有网络实例。

VBR：边界路由器实例。

CCN：云连接网实例
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the network instance
parameters.help_zh: 网络实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: child_instance_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the CEN instance
parameters.help_zh: 云企业网实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: cen_owner_id
